definitions.gloss: to crash, to plummet, to fall from a height
definitions.explanation: To fall suddenly from a great height to the ground. Used especially for aircraft, but also for people falling from buildings or cliffs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{墜落|ついらく}した。
⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墜落|ついらく}して⟦{炎上|えんじょう}した→炎上する：23204_enjousuru⟧。
examples.english: The helicopter crashed into a mountain and burst into flames.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧⟦{旅客機|りょかくき}→旅客機：17838_ryokakuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墜落|ついらく}し、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A small passenger plane crashed immediately after takeoff, and all passengers were rescued.

notes:
A compound of {墜|つい} (to fall) and {落|らく} (to drop). Primarily used for aircraft crashes and falls from high places. The word carries a sense of sudden, violent, uncontrolled descent, unlike a gentle or planned descent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{墜落|ついらく}する: an airplane crashes
- ⟦{墜落|ついらく}→墜落：18763_tsuiraku⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: crash accident
- ⟦{墜落|ついらく}→墜落：18763_tsuiraku⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: crash site
- ⟦{墜落|ついらく}→墜落：18763_tsuiraku⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause of a crash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落下|らっか}する→落下する：21740_rakkasuru⟧: to fall, to drop — a more general and neutral term for falling; can apply to any object
- ⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fall, to tumble down — implies rolling or tumbling, often from a ledge or stairs
- {不時着|ふじちゃく}する: to make an emergency landing — a controlled crash landing, less catastrophic
